quote_policy: Keep original quote currency; never assume USD=USDT=USDC.
replacement_policy: A missing venue series remains missing. Another venue is an independent comparison, not a replacement observation.

binance_perpetual.unit: base_asset for selected linear USDT contracts
binance_perpetual.comparability: Do not aggregate with other venues until counting convention verified

bybit_perpetual.counting_convention: sum of both sides per current official documentation; singleOpenInterest is a distinct field

funding.stored: actual raw settlement rate and settlement timestamp
funding.interval: Instrument metadata retained in raw catalogs; do not assume uniform 8-hour interval

defillama.warning: TVL change is not a net-flow measurement

oi_history.bybit_fields: singleOpenInterest preferred when present; otherwise openInterest
oi_history.aggregation: disabled across venues until conventions verified
